title: Smart Data Models - Open Energy Ontology - PowerGeneratingUnit
description: A power generating unit is an energy transformation unit that has the function to produce electrical energy (oeo:OEO_00000334 'power generating unit', Open Energy Ontology v2.14.0, definition verbatim; German 'Kraftwerksblock'). Modelled generically: the specific OEO subclass (gas fired power unit, lignite power unit, wind energy converting unit, PV panel, ...) is carried in oeoClass.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PowerGeneratingUnit'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. The name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point, LineString or Polygon (RFC 7946). Not an OEO term: OEO has no direct geometry on artificial objects, so the NGSI-LD core location is used.

oeoClass.description: Relationship. The specific OEO class of this entity (rdf:type), as the class IRI. OEO v2.14.0 declares 30 classes in the 'power generating unit' hierarchy (this class and all its subclasses), all allowed here: PERC panel = oeo:OEO_00280011; PMSG wind energy converting unit = oeo:OEO_00280008; PV panel = oeo:OEO_00000348; SCIG wind energy converting unit = oeo:OEO_00280017; biofuel power unit = oeo:OEO_00000003; biogas power unit = oeo:OEO_00000005; coal power unit = oeo:OEO_00000008; direct drive wind energy converting unit = oeo:OEO_00280018; fueled power unit = oeo:OEO_00000175; gas fired power unit = oeo:OEO_00000017; gearbox wind energy converting unit = oeo:OEO_00280019; geothermal power unit = oeo:OEO_00000019; hard coal power unit = oeo:OEO_00000021; hydro power unit = oeo:OEO_00010085; hydrogen power unit = oeo:OEO_00000022; lignite power unit = oeo:OEO_00000024; marine current energy converting unit = oeo:OEO_00010108; marine tidal energy converting unit = oeo:OEO_00010109; marine wave energy converting unit = oeo:OEO_00010110; nuclear power unit = oeo:OEO_00000029; oil power unit = oeo:OEO_00000030; power generating unit = oeo:OEO_00000334; power-only generating unit = oeo:OEO_00010401; renewable power unit = oeo:OEO_00010361; solar power unit = oeo:OEO_00000034; solar thermal power unit = oeo:OEO_00000035; solid biomass power unit = oeo:OEO_00000037; steam power unit = oeo:OEO_00310028; waste power unit = oeo:OEO_00000041; wind energy converting unit = oeo:OEO_00000044.

partOf.description: Relationship. The PowerPlant this unit is part of (BFO 'part of').

powerPlantOperator.description: Property. Name(s) of the power plant operator(s): the agent(s) operating the generation station (oeo:OEO_00140130 'power plant operator' is an agent class in OEO; carried here as the operator's name).

uses.description: Relationship. The fuel(s) or energy carrier(s) the object requires as input to work (oeo:OEO_00000503 'uses'), given as OEO class IRIs, e.g. natural gas = oeo:OEO_00000292, mineral oil = oeo:OEO_00010317, lignite = oeo:OEO_00000251, hard coal = oeo:OEO_00000204. Any OEO portion-of-matter / energy-carrier class IRI is allowed.

nameplateCapacity.description: Property. Nameplate capacity: the maximum power the object can generate under nominal conditions (gross). Units:'MW'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00230003) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

declaredNetCapacity.description: Property. Declared net capacity: the maximum power the object can deliver to the electrical grid (gross capacity minus own consumption). Units:'MW'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00230002) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

efficiencyValue.description: Property. Efficiency value: the ratio between the useful outputs and the inputs of the energy transformation, as a fraction 0..1 (for storage: round-trip efficiency). Units:'C62 (ratio)'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00140050) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

fullLoadHours.description: Property. Full load hours: annual energy generated divided by the declared net capacity. Units:'HUR (hours per year)'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00140144) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

netCapacityFactor.description: Property. Net capacity factor: net electricity generation over a time step divided by the declared net capacity times the duration of the time step, as a fraction 0..1. Units:'C62 (ratio)'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00240016) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

operationalLifeTime.description: Property. Operational life time: the lifetime of the object, measured from the end of construction to the start of decommissioning. Units:'ANN (years)'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00020178) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

commissioningEnd.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Date'. Commissioning end: the date on which commissioning finished, i.e. the start of commercial operation (oeo:OEO_00020421, a temporal instant in OEO, flattened to an ISO 8601 date).

decommissioningStart.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Date'. Decommissioning start: the date on which decommissioning began (oeo:OEO_00020417, flattened to an ISO 8601 date).

operationalStatus.description: Property. Operational status of the object. Not an OEO term (OEO has no operating-status vocabulary for artificial objects); the values follow the Open Power System Data / BNetzA power plant list (operating, reserve, seasonal_conservation, shutdown_temporary, shutdown, special_case), plus planned and underConstruction.

eicCode.description: Property. ENTSO-E Energy Identification Code (EIC) of this object. Not an OEO term; added because it is the identifier used for generation units, plants and grid nodes in European market data.
